dress_code.women: Traditional sarees, half-sarees, or modest chudidars with a dupatta.

dos: Carry Physical Cash: Note that while hundi counters have digital links, the physical prasad and quick darshan ticket booths strictly require hard cash over standard mobile UPI apps.
Keep Shoes at Main Gate: Advise readers to only deposit footwear at the official temple counter near the entry gate rather than local vendor stalls to make collecting them simple when exiting
donts: Do Not Bring Massive Bags: Avoid large personal luggage pieces, as the entrance security checks use tight metal detectors.

No Western Beachwear: Dress respectfully in classic Indian clothing (Sarees/Chudidars for women, Dhotis/Kurtas for men). Shorts, short skirts, or sleeveless tops are not socially accepted inside the prayer halls.
